units.title: 留宿活动里的个人用品

materials.title: Sleepover Classroom Plan 028
materials.text: For the school sleepover, keep your bag under your own bed. Use your own toothbrush. Quiet time starts at eight thirty. If you feel unwell at night, call the adult helper. In the morning, fold your blanket before breakfast. Put borrowed pillows in the basket.

questions.prompt: A friend puts a bag in the walking path. You say, "____"
options: Put it under your own bed.
Put it on the sleeping child.
questions.explanation: A包自己床下，非通道；B压熟睡人、C堵路不合放置规则。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to use your toothbrush. You say, "____"
options: Put my toothbrush in your shoe.
questions.explanation: B各用本人牙刷；A共用、C鞋内均违个人用品用途。

questions.prompt: It is eight thirty and a friend speaks loudly. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C8:30安静开始；A/B更响违时间安排。

questions.prompt: A friend feels unwell at night. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A不适找成人；B隐瞒、C独离校非求助程序。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves a borrowed pillow on the bed in the morning. You say, "____"
options: Put it with the breakfast food.
questions.explanation: B借枕回篮；A当己物、C食物旁不是收纳安排。

units.title: 买水果时说出真正需要

materials.title: Market Asking Politely 028
materials.text: Choose the useful sentence for each child’s need at the fruit stall.

questions.prompt: You need apples for Mum, but you do not know which bag has apples. What do you ask?
options: Which bag has the apples, please?
questions.explanation: A辨苹果袋符合采购需要；B桌跑、C月高无关。

questions.prompt: The seller gives you five pears, but your list says four. What do you say?
options: Sorry, I need four pears, please.
Please give me the whole stall.
questions.explanation: B明确清单四梨纠多给；A等同数字错误；C全摊超需求。

questions.prompt: You want ripe fruit to eat today. What do you ask?
options: Which fruit is ready to eat today?
questions.explanation: C问今天可吃成熟果；A/B拟人无关选择。

questions.prompt: Your bag is too heavy, and Dad is beside you. What do you say?
options: Could you help me carry this bag?
Could you add more heavy fruit?
questions.explanation: A请求分担重袋；B加重反需要；C藏鞋无关。

questions.prompt: The seller gives your change. You want to count it before leaving. What do you say?
options: I will throw the coins away.
May I count the change, please?
questions.explanation: B礼貌提出核找零；A丢币、C衣袖不核交易。

units.title: 去亲戚家做客的十段句子

materials.title: Family Visit Ten Sentences 028
materials.text: Choose the word or reply that fits each full family-visit situation.

questions.prompt: Liam and I are brothers. ____ grandma is waiting at the door.
questions.explanation: A说话者与Liam共同祖母用Our；B His仅他的、C Her她的均不表达本句共同物主。

questions.prompt: The baby is asleep, so we walk into the room ____.
questions.explanation: B安静走不扰婴；A生气地、C饥饿地不达此目的。

questions.prompt: The dog sees us and ____ its tail.
questions.explanation: C dog单三并列sees用wags；A原形、B分词不能与sees同级作此谓语。

questions.prompt: Please put your shoes together. Do not leave ____ in the doorway.
questions.explanation: A leave后宾格them指鞋；B they主格，C their需名词。

questions.prompt: I cannot reach the cup. ____ you help me?
questions.explanation: B Can you help请求帮忙；A Are、C Is不接原形help且C不配you。

questions.prompt: There are three ____ at the table, one for each child.
questions.explanation: C three要求chairs标准复数；A单数，B错加es。

questions.prompt: I am full. I do ____ want another sandwich.
questions.explanation: A do not want标准否定；B do no want不合，C do is want不构成句子。

questions.prompt: The gift is from my aunt. I want to thank ____.
questions.explanation: B thank后宾格her；A主格，C物主不作此人物宾语。

questions.prompt: ____ do we go home? After the cake.
questions.explanation: C After cake答时机When；A地点、B人物不对应。

questions.prompt: This blanket feels ____. It is nice for the baby.
questions.explanation: A soft柔软符合毯触感和舒适；B声音响、C迟不描述本句手感。

units.title: 工坊准备时的五个回答

materials.title: Workshop Ready Replies 028
materials.text:
Match each question to the reply that fits it. Use each reply once.
A. In the basket beside the door.
B. Because the new paint may still be soft.
C. The teacher holding the class list.
D. Only when the helper has checked the tools.
E. A small towel and a water bottle.

questions.prompt: Where should the wet aprons go?
options: In the basket beside the door.
Because the new paint may still be soft.
The teacher holding the class list.
Only when the helper has checked the tools.
A small towel and a water bottle.
questions.explanation: A门旁篮回答围裙去处；B原因、C人员、D工具核后条件、E自备物不答Where。

questions.prompt: Why should we wait before pressing the painted surface?
options: In the basket beside the door.
Because the new paint may still be soft.
The teacher holding the class list.
Only when the helper has checked the tools.
A small towel and a water bottle.
questions.explanation: B新漆可能软解释不能按；A篮位、C教师、D工具检查、E毛巾水瓶都非该表面状态原因。

questions.prompt: Who can confirm that our whole class is here?
options: In the basket beside the door.
Because the new paint may still be soft.
The teacher holding the class list.
Only when the helper has checked the tools.
A small towel and a water bottle.
questions.explanation: C拿班表教师答人员；A位置、B漆软、D工具条件、E用品不答Who。

questions.prompt: When may we begin using the shared equipment?
options: In the basket beside the door.
Because the new paint may still be soft.
The teacher holding the class list.
Only when the helper has checked the tools.
A small towel and a water bottle.
questions.explanation: D帮手核工具后答开始时机；A围裙篮、B漆原因、C教师、E用品不构成设备启动条件。

questions.prompt: What should each pupil bring for the afternoon?
options: In the basket beside the door.
Because the new paint may still be soft.
The teacher holding the class list.
Only when the helper has checked the tools.
A small towel and a water bottle.
questions.explanation: E毛巾水瓶为自备用品；A篮位、B原因、C人、D时机不列用品。

materials.title: Museum Loan Box Bank 028
materials.text:
Read the full passage and choose from the bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. label B. under C. dry D. before E. carefully
Our class lends a model to the town library. We write its name on a ____1____. A soft cloth goes ____2____ the model in the box, not on its roof. The box must stay ____3____ during the journey. We carry it ____4____ because the small paper windows can bend. The teacher checks the packing ____5____ closing the lid.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A label标签可写模型名；B under方位、C dry状态、D before先后、E carefully方式均非书写载物名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B under与not on roof对应模型下方；A label名词、C dry形容词、D before时间、E carefully副词不表该空间关系。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C stay dry保持干燥；A label、B under、D before、E carefully不能作本句防湿状态表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: E carefully修饰carry且保护纸窗；A label、B under、C dry、D before不表达所需搬运方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: D before closing先查后盖；A label、B under、C dry、E carefully不连接该时间关系。

units.title: 取回展品时的五个确认

materials.title: Display Collection Replies 028
materials.text:
Match the question with the best reply. Use each bank answer once.
A. The helper at the collection desk.
B. Because the paper edges are sharp.
C. After your name has been called.
D. Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
E. In the folder with the matching class number.

questions.prompt: Who checks our collection slips?
options: The helper at the collection desk.
Because the paper edges are sharp.
After your name has been called.
Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
In the folder with the matching class number.
questions.explanation: A取件台帮手核票答Who；B原因、C时机、D许可、E文件夹位置非人员。

questions.prompt: Why should we not slide our hands along the card edges?
options: The helper at the collection desk.
Because the paper edges are sharp.
After your name has been called.
Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
In the folder with the matching class number.
questions.explanation: B纸边锐解释动作限制；A人员、C叫名、D支架许可、E班号夹均不答Why。

questions.prompt: When should I come forward to collect my work?
options: The helper at the collection desk.
Because the paper edges are sharp.
After your name has been called.
Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
In the folder with the matching class number.
questions.explanation: C叫到名后答前来时机；A人员、B纸边原因、D触看许可、E存放夹不答When。

questions.prompt: May I look at that model before taking it away?
options: The helper at the collection desk.
Because the paper edges are sharp.
After your name has been called.
Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
In the folder with the matching class number.
questions.explanation: D可以但留支架上答查看条件；A核票人员、B纸边、C叫名、E夹位置均不回答查看许可。

questions.prompt: Where are our class’s drawings kept?
options: The helper at the collection desk.
Because the paper edges are sharp.
After your name has been called.
Yes, if you leave it on its stand.
In the folder with the matching class number.
questions.explanation: E相同班号文件夹答作品存处；A人员、B原因、C时机、D查看许可非存储位置。

units.title: 没有手机信号的那张手绘图

materials.title: Quiet Paper Map Story 028
materials.text:
The class visited a small village for a walking project. Ana expected to follow a map on her phone, but the signal disappeared near the hill. She complained that the village was impossible to explore. Her classmate Rui took out a paper route drawn by the host. It marked the school, the well and a large chestnut tree.
At first, Ana thought the sketch looked too simple. Then she noticed that the host had drawn the tree exactly where the road split. The sketch did not list every shop, but it showed the points needed for their walk. They reached the village hall on time. Ana still liked the detailed phone map for other trips. She wrote in her notes that a useful guide was one that worked for the place and purpose, not always the one with the most details.

questions.prompt: What problem does Ana meet?
options: Her phone map loses its signal near the hill.
Every road in the village vanishes.
Rui has no map of any kind.
questions.explanation: A山边无手机信号；B路未消失；C Rui有纸图；D主人提供路线。

questions.prompt: Why does Ana first doubt the paper sketch?
options: It has too many shop advertisements.
questions.explanation: B too simple；A广告、C玻璃、D他国无据。

questions.prompt: What makes the tree an important feature?
options: It is the only tree in the world.
It marks the split in the road.
questions.explanation: C分岔地标；A遮厅、B全球唯一、D发射器均非信息。

questions.prompt: What does Ana decide about phone maps?
options: They must replace every paper map.
They can still help on other journeys.
questions.explanation: D仍喜欢其他旅程用；A全无用、B全替代、C无详情都过度。

questions.prompt: What is the story’s main idea?
options: Usefulness depends on context and purpose.
The most detailed guide always wins.
People should never ask a host for help.
questions.explanation: A末句适地适目的；B总详情最多反文；C主人图助行；D简图确带到。

units.title: 义卖收据上的捐款金额

materials.title: Shop Receipt Donation 028
materials.text: At the craft fair, a buyer paid twenty yuan for a notebook and added five yuan for the garden fund. The first receipt showed only twenty-five yuan under "Notebook." The volunteer realised that this made the notebook’s price look higher than it was. She rewrote the receipt with two lines: twenty yuan for the item and five yuan as an optional donation. The total stayed the same. Later, the stall used the same two-line format for every purchase with a donation. Buyers could see what they had bought and what they had chosen to give separately.

questions.prompt: The notebook itself cost twenty-five yuan.
questions.explanation: B正确：物价二十另捐五；A把总额当商品价。

questions.prompt: The first receipt combined the purchase and donation under one label.
questions.explanation: A正确：25全记Notebook；B否认初记录问题。

questions.prompt: Rewriting the receipt changed how much the buyer had paid in total.
questions.explanation: B正确：total same，仅分项；A把分类纠正当金额变化。

questions.prompt: The donation was optional.
questions.explanation: A正确：optional donation明确；B否认自愿属性。

questions.prompt: The new format distinguished buying from giving.
questions.explanation: A正确：两行各记物价与自愿捐赠；B否认透明分项目的。

materials.title: Museum Visit Word Forms 028
materials.text:
Use the correct one-word form of the given word for every gap.
1. Last Monday, we ____1____ (choose) the shorter route to the museum.
2. Two model ____2____ (mouse) stood beside a display about small animals.
3. The new route was ____3____ (easy) than the steep path.
4. Look! A volunteer is ____4____ (make) a paper model for the visitors.
5. The guide led our group ____5____ (safe; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) through the crowded entrance.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use CHOOSE.
questions.explanation: 接受chose：Last Monday要求过去，choose不规则；choose原形、choosed错误、choosing分词均不合过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use MOUSE.
questions.explanation: 接受mice：two model mouse为动物模型，mouse动物复数mice；mouse单数、mouses用于本题动物标准复数不合，mices重复加s错误。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use EASY.
questions.explanation: 接受easier：than比较，辅音y变i加er；easy原级、easiest最高级、easyer拼写错。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use MAKE.
questions.explanation: 接受making：is进行时，make去e加ing；make原形、makeing拼写错、made过去式不合本句正在制作。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from SAFE.
questions.explanation: 接受safely：本空明确要求SAFE派生的常规-ly副词。safe的平义副词或补语、safer/safest的比较或最高级可能在其他英语语境合法，但不满足本题-ly任务形式；safety为名词也不合。未列形式仍按复核处理，不据本题判定这些词在所有英语中错误。

units.title: 给活动办公室打电话时

materials.title: Telephone Office Functions 028
materials.text: Choose the sentence that best achieves the caller’s purpose.

questions.prompt: The organiser is unavailable. You want to leave your return-call number. What should you say?
options: May I leave a number for the organiser to call me back?
I will call every person in town.
questions.explanation: B明确留言回电号请求；A让猜、C群呼无关。

questions.prompt: You heard a booking code but are unsure of one letter. What should you ask?
options: Could you repeat that letter, please?
questions.explanation: C请求重说不确定字母；A泛问代码、B改所有预约不澄清听漏。

questions.prompt: You are told that the event moved from Tuesday to Wednesday. You want to confirm the change. What should you say?
options: So the event is now on Wednesday, correct?
Tuesday and Wednesday are the same day.
I will arrive on any day without checking.
questions.explanation: A复述新周三确认；B同日错误；C任到不核实。

questions.prompt: You need to know whether an email is confirmation or only a request receipt. What should you ask?
options: Does this email confirm my place, or just acknowledge the request?
questions.explanation: B直接分辨确认席位与收到申请；A设备大小、C删全讯无关状态。

questions.prompt: You cannot attend and want to free your booked place for another person. What should you say?
options: Please keep it empty without telling anyone.
I will claim that I attended.
I need to cancel my place so someone else can use it.
questions.explanation: C明确取消并释放席位；A隐匿空位、B虚称出席不达到目标。
